title: Crypto-Cash Back: Getting Started with Crypto Rewards
summary: Explains how to start earning and redeem Crypto-Cash Back rewards in crypto: eligible purchases earn 2.0%, crypto redemption can be initiated once your rewards balance reaches at least $30, and you can organize accrual using virtual cards (when available). It also notes crypto redemptions are available and purchase protection is No.
faqs: What percent crypto-cash back do I earn on eligible purchases?
How much reward balance do I need before I can redeem to crypto?
Are crypto redemptions available on my account?
Can I use virtual cards to organize which spending earns rewards?
How do I redeem once I hit the $30 threshold?
Is purchase protection available on this card? The document says it is No.
